verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a dedicated GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for automatically testing agents on each change, backed by a terminal CLI for managing scenarios and runs and an SDK for programmatic access. That covers running evals in CI. Gating deploys on the results is only implied by the CI workflow framing and is never shown explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of pass/fail thresholds or exit codes that block deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CI workflow.
